stories.title: UN says Pentagon plan to livestream execution of Fort Hood shooter would amount to torture – US politics live

en.title: UN says Pentagon plan to livestream execution of Fort Hood shooter would amount to torture – US politics live
en.summary: The United Nations has condemned a Pentagon proposal to broadcast the execution of a Fort Hood shooter online, with US lawmakers describing it as grotesque and comparing it to practices associated with terror groups and authoritarian regimes.

stories.title: Renshaw keeps Australia’s hopes intact against South Africa after Maddinson gamble fails

en.title: Renshaw keeps Australia's hopes intact against South Africa after Maddinson gamble fails
en.summary: Australia's opening batsman Nic Maddinson was dismissed without scoring in the first Test against South Africa in Durban, contributing to a difficult start for the touring team. Renshaw and Cummins subsequently steadied Australia's innings by resisting the hosts' bowling attack.

stories.title: Australia asked too much of Nic Maddinson. Matt Renshaw showed why

en.title: Australia asked too much of Nic Maddinson. Matt Renshaw showed why
en.summary: Matt Renshaw's return to Test cricket has progressed gradually over several years, contrasting sharply with Nic Maddinson's abrupt recall to the Australian team.

stories.title: Australia vs South Africa cricket as it happened: Maddinson return falls flat, Cummins, Renshaw mount rearguard before bad light ends play

en.title: Australia vs South Africa cricket as it happened: Maddinson return falls flat, Cummins, Renshaw mount rearguard before bad light ends play
en.summary: Nic Maddinson recorded the longest duck by an Australian Test opener, marking a poor start to Australia's Test tour of South Africa. Cummins and Renshaw later provided resistance before play ended due to bad light.

stories.title: Litchfield fireworks help Australia to ODI victory over Bangladesh

en.title: Litchfield fireworks help Australia to ODI victory over Bangladesh
en.summary: Phoebe Litchfield scored a rapid half-century to lead Australia to a seven-wicket victory over Bangladesh in their opening ODI match in Brisbane.

stories.title: Phoebe Litchfield powers Australia to crushing ODI victory over Bangladesh

en.title: Phoebe Litchfield powers Australia to crushing ODI victory over Bangladesh
en.summary: Australia defeated Bangladesh in a one-day international, with opener Phoebe Litchfield scoring 77 runs to help chase down Bangladesh's total of 166 in just over 25 overs. Australia maintained their undefeated record at Allan Border Field.

stories.title: Perth Bears chief executive Anthony De Ceglie quits

en.title: Perth Bears chief executive Anthony De Ceglie quits
en.summary: Anthony De Ceglie has departed from his role as chief executive of the Perth Bears. De Ceglie previously held positions as director of news and current affairs at Seven West Media and editor-in-chief of the West Australian newspaper.

stories.title: Anthony De Ceglie steps down as Perth Bears CEO

en.title: Anthony De Ceglie steps down as Perth Bears CEO
en.summary: Anthony De Ceglie has stepped down as CEO of the Perth Bears, the NRL team from Western Australia. No reason for his departure was disclosed.

en.title: Former UN human rights chief Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, an 85-year-old South Africa-born former UN human rights chief, received the Nobel Peace Prize for her work advancing peace and international law.

en.title: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize after consideration of over 280 nominees for the honour.

stories.title: Bad light stops play with Renshaw on the brink of drought-breaking milestone

en.title: Bad light stops play with Renshaw on the brink of drought-breaking milestone
en.summary: Matt Renshaw's attempt to score his first Test half-century in nine years was interrupted when bad light halted play on the opening day of the Test against South Africa. Renshaw was four runs short of the milestone.

en.summary: Media coverage is shifting focus to the Nobel Peace Prize after earlier Nobel Prize announcements have been completed.

stories.title: US tries to dismantle ICC; Israel denounces Nobel Peace Prize winner

en.title: US tries to dismantle ICC; Israel denounces Nobel Peace Prize winner
en.summary: The International Criminal Court criticized the US for what it characterized as an assault on the rule of law as the Trump administration seeks to dismantle the institution. Israel has attacked Navi Pillay, who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: Human rights judge wins Nobel Peace Prize

en.title: Human rights judge wins Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navi Pillay, a South African jurist serving on the International Court of Justice, has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. Her legal career has included investigating Benjamin Netanyahu for alleged war crimes.

en.summary: David Rowe, a multiple Walkley award-winning cartoonist, creates daily political cartoons and illustrations for the Chanticleer column.

en.title: Ex Seven news boss steps down as CEO of NRL's newest club
en.summary: Anthony De Ceglie has resigned as CEO of the Perth Bears after 18 months in the role, stepping down months before the team's inaugural game. He thanked NRL commissioner Peter V'landys upon his departure.
